historical_references.reference: Irisna is believed to be an alternate name for the goddess Durga, who is associated with the slaying of the demon Mahishasura. This reference comes from Hindu mythology and dates back to at least the 7th century CE.

Another reference suggests that Irisna is a name for the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning. This name is mentioned in the 13th century CE Indian epic Mahabharata.
